assessment.applicability_basis: Swedish reporting described dozens of AI-generated investment advertisements impersonating roughly 15–20 Swedish financial figures. IEEE 7014.1-2026 applies to partner-based GPAI systems using emulated empathy in human-AI partnering contexts. These sources describe synthetic videos/advertisements impersonating real people, not an empathic AI partner interacting with a user; they also do not describe personal or emotional data collection by such a partner system. The required system context is absent.

assessment.applicability_basis: The reported campaign used AI-generated impersonations of Swedish financial figures in advertisements directed at Swedish investors in October 2025, after Article 5 began applying on 2 February 2025. The AI output was used in Sweden, bringing this occurrence within Article 2(1)(c) even though the generating provider and deployer are not identified. This is an occurrence-level scope decision, not attribution of legal responsibility.
assessment.finding_basis: TV4 and Sveriges Radio report dozens of AI-generated advertisements falsely depicting 15–20 Swedish financial figures as endorsing investments, directed at Swedish investors; they attribute at least 5,000 victims and approximately SEK 500 million in aggregate loss to the campaign. The fabricated endorsements materially misrepresented financial authority to influence investment choices, and the reported scale of realized loss supports significant harm. The totals remain attributed estimates, and this finding does not identify or assign liability to a provider or deployer.

taxonomy_relationships.rationale: The sources attribute the investment objective and tactic selection to human scammers using AI-generated media.
